title: Grateful Dead Live at Community War Memorial Auditorium on 1982-04-09
lineage: Master Cassettes (Nakamichi CR-7A)> Tascam DA-3000 (DSF 1-bit/5.6 MHz) > Tascam Hi-Res Editor (.wav 24-bit/96k) > Adobe Audition CC 2025 > TLH flac2496
source: Bob Wagner's Master Audience Cassettes; Nakamichi 700 mics > Sony TC-D5M (Maxell XLII-S90)

ai_review.summary: Excellent front‑of‑house soundboard capture of a scorching Mississippi Half‑Step and a phenomenal space‑filled Other One, with high energy throughout.
ai_review.review: The reviewer, who attended the concert, praises the recording as sounding like you’re standing FOH—clear, immersive, and professionally mixed. Musically the show shines with a hot Mississippi Half‑Step kicking off set 2 and an especially powerful Space → The Other One sequence that “blew [their] mind.” Overall the performance is described as fiery and the audio quality as great.

ai_rating.rationale: A single, detailed 5‑star review highlights both an outstanding performance and excellent recording quality, warranting a near‑top rating despite limited data points.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Sounds like standing front‑of‑house; clear, well‑balanced mix with no noted flaws.

show_quality.setlist_flow: Strong opening of set 2 with MSWS and a seamless, high‑impact transition from Space into The Other One.
